hero.title: Dog Spotlight pattern
hero.description: Highlight a curated set of dogs — e.g. longest-waiting residents — in a 4-across grid, each linking out to their listing.

example.title: Example
example.descriptionRest: — the same source-agnostic shape used by the local-manifest adoptable-pets loader, so hand-curated data and a future automated pull (GetBuddy, Petfinder, local manifest) share one type.

withoutLink.title: Without a detailsUrl
withoutLink.descriptionAfter: still renders its card (photo, name, breed, age • gender) but with no CTA button — there is nothing to link to yet.

standard.title: Standard

manifestType.mid2: ) — the same manifest shape used elsewhere in the ecosystem, so this data can start as a hand-curated array and later be swapped for an automated GetBuddy/Petfinder/local-manifest pull without changing the component.

standard.selection: Selection of which dogs to feature is entirely a call-site concern — pass in exactly the curated list, in the order you want it shown. There is no built-in sort/filter.
standard.grid: Grid is fixed at up to 4 across (`grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4`) — this component's whole purpose is the 4-card spotlight row, not a general-purpose gallery, so there is deliberately no `columns` prop.
standard.ageGender: Age • gender line is computed via `resolvePetAgeLabel()` from `lib/pet-age.ts` (never hand-rolled) using each item's `age`/`birthDate`.

ctaButton.middle: ", via `labels.ctaPrefix`) renders only when `detailsUrl` is present — a dog without one still renders its card, just without a button. `ctaPrefix` is a plain word/phrase (e.g. "Meet", "Adopt"), never a
ctaButton.after: -style template string, so it's safe to pass straight through i18next's `t()` without colliding with its own interpolation syntax.

standard.emptyState: If `dogs` is empty, the component renders nothing — no empty-state placeholder.
standard.distinctFromAdoptablePets: Distinct from `AdoptablePetsSection` (the full adoptable-pets listing shell with Petfinder/Adopt-a-Pet/GetBuddy/local-manifest provider modes) — this is a small, separate curated highlight, not a listing provider.
